verdictNote: The face station is adult-only by construction: the plan gate (F1) refuses the child before stage 1, so no stage ran and no station output exists. Every downstream adult assumption (F3-F7) is therefore unreachable proof rather than an exercised failure. A real child run first needs a goal image for peds_patient_child and a case record, then child tone anchors, a lid-conform case mapping, a child chain subject, and a face-fit target.
